# Psalm 149 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Praise Yah! Sing to-YHWH a-song new, his-praise in-assembly-of the-faithful.

**2** Let-rejoice Israel in-his-maker; sons-of Zion let-them-be-glad in-their-king.

**3** Let-them-praise his-name with-dancing; with-tambourine and-lyre let-them-sing-praises to-him.

**4** For takes-pleasure YHWH in-his-people; he-adorns the-humble with-salvation.

**5** Let-exult the-faithful in-glory; let-them-sing-for-joy on their-beds.

**6** Exaltations-of God in-their-throat, and-sword double-edged in-their-hand,

**7** To-execute vengeance on-the-nations, punishments on-the-peoples,

**8** To-bind their-kings with-chains, and-their-nobles with-fetters-of iron,

**9** To-execute on-them judgment written; glory it for-all his-faithful. Praise Yah!

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **149:6**: 'Exaltations-of God in-their-throat, and-sword double-edged in-their-hand' — worship and warfare combined; praise as the weapon of the faithful.

— EMET
